paper.title_en: Certifying closed labs in device-independent tests of indefinite causality
paper.abstract_en: Indefinite causal order allows processes in which the order of events is not predetermined, enabling information-processing advantages unattainable with fixed causal structures. A long-standing open problem is whether such processes can be certified without trusting the devices used to demonstrate them, analogous to device-independent certifications of Bell nonlocality. Causal inequalities offer a route towards this goal, since their violation is intended to rule out all definite causal structures. However, fully device-independent certification of indefinite causal order remains elusive. The difficulty lies in the closed laboratories assumption, which requires each party to interact at most once with systems that mediate communication. Without this assumption, ordinary two-way communication can reproduce causal-inequality violations without involving indefinite causal order. Yet an untrusted device could violate the assumption by interacting with the mediating system more than once, while remaining undetected from input-output statistics alone. We address this loophole by embedding a minimal set of additional experimental components into a certification scheme. These elements probabilistically probe the underlying process, enabling the closed laboratories assumption to be validated directly within the protocol. Our framework provides operationally meaningful minimal-assumption tests of indefinite causal order, clarifying its distinction from nonlocality and paving the way for cryptographic and self-testing applications.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨不定因果序的设备无关认证，属于广义相对论基础中因果结构议题；提出了通过嵌入额外实验组件来验证"封闭实验室"假设的方案，理论上较深入且方法思路新颖。主题与候选标签general_relativity_foundations一致，未涉及度规仿射、Palatini或其他修改引力理论。
decision.title_zh: 在不定因果性的设备无关检验中认证封闭实验室
decision.abstract_zh: 不定因果序允许事件顺序并非预先确定的过程，从而实现固定因果结构无法达到的信息处理优势。一个长期悬而未决的问题是，此类过程能否在无需信任用于演示它们的设备的情况下被认证，类似于贝尔非定域性的设备无关认证。因果不等式为这一目标提供了一条途径，因为对其的违反旨在排除所有确定性的因果结构。然而，对不定因果序的完全设备无关认证仍然难以实现。困难在于封闭实验室假设，该假设要求每一方与传递通信的系统至多相互作用一次。若没有这一假设，普通的双向通信就可以在完全不涉及不定因果序的情况下重现因果不等式的违反。然而，一个不可信的设备可以通过与中介系统相互作用不止一次来违反该假设，而仅凭输入-输出统计无法察觉。我们通过将一小组额外实验组件嵌入认证方案来解决这一漏洞。这些元素对底层过程进行概率性探测，使封闭实验室假设能够在协议内部直接得到验证。我们的框架提供了对不定因果序进行具有操作意义的最小假设检验，厘清了其与非定域性的区别，并为密码学与自检验应用铺平了道路。
